claims.quote: This site sets no cookies
claims.statement: The public website sets no cookies on visitors.
claims.tier_basis: The public site's cookie behaviour falls under an item the buyer uses but has not made a condition of price, terms or closing, and no stated threshold reaches it. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics
claims.statement: The public website runs no analytics.
claims.tier_basis: Analytics on the public pages sits under the same buyer-used item as the cookie claim, with no stated threshold reaching it and no dependent item it would defeat. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: The demo sets one
claims.statement: The demo sets exactly one cookie.
claims.tier_basis: The buyer said the free demo is of no commercial interest and it will never use it again, and no stated threshold names demo cookies. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: It counts page views with Cloudflare Web Analytics
claims.statement: The site counts page views using Cloudflare Web Analytics.
claims.tier_basis: Page-view counting on the public site is under an item the buyer uses but has not made a condition, and no stated threshold reaches it. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: which uses no cookies
claims.statement: The site's page-view counting via Cloudflare Web Analytics uses no cookies.
claims.tier_basis: Whether the counting service uses cookies is a detail of a public-site behaviour the buyer uses but has not made a condition of price, terms or closing. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: does not identify visitors
claims.statement: The site's page-view counting via Cloudflare Web Analytics does not identify visitors.
claims.tier_basis: A failure here would admit visitor identification on the public site; the firm's stated thresholds concern seller code, seller materials and its own deal terms, not its website visits. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: The demo sets a single cookie that identifies your browser to it
claims.statement: The demo sets a single cookie whose function is to identify the visitor's browser to the demo.
claims.tier_basis: The buyer said it will never use the demo again, so a false statement about the demo's cookie affects nothing the firm is paying for. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: so that your conversation is yours and you can return to it
claims.statement: The demo stores each visitor's conversation under the identifier of the single cookie it set in that visitor's browser, so that the stored conversation can be retrieved for that visitor on a later visit.
claims.tier_basis: Demo conversation storage matters only to demo users, and the buyer has said it will never use the demo and named no threshold reaching it. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: It records when a session was opened, a hash of the address it came from, and how many questions were asked
claims.statement: The demo records only session metadata: when the session was opened, a hash of the source address, and the question count.
claims.tier_basis: Though this is a boundary claim whose failure would admit wider demo recording, the buyer will never use the demo and no stated threshold reaches it. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: Your questions and the answers are kept for a few days and then deleted
claims.statement: The demo includes a deletion process that removes stored demo questions and answers once the few-day retention period ends.
claims.tier_basis: Demo retention and deletion concern a path the buyer said it will never use again, and no stated threshold names the demo. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: What you type there is sent to that service to produce the reply
claims.statement: Text typed into the demo is transmitted to the hosted inference service to generate the reply.
claims.tier_basis: Transmission of demo text to a hosted inference service sits on the free demo path, not a paid engagement, so the firm's walk-away condition as written does not reach it, and the buyer said it will never use the demo. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: What a client tells us at intake and what a seller supplies are held in the engagement file
claims.statement: Client intake information and seller-supplied materials are held in the engagement file.
claims.tier_basis: If intake information and seller materials were not held in the engagement file, the firm's deal terms could sit outside the one store it permits, which the firm cannot repair on Tuuyi's side. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the firm's deal terms being stored anywhere other than the engagement file".

claims.quote: for the period set in the engagement letter
claims.statement: The engagement file is retained for the period stated in the engagement letter.
claims.tier_basis: If retention did not follow the engagement letter as stated, the working record could be gone before the committee asks to see it a year later, and the firm cannot reconstruct a record it never held. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the working record not being kept, because the committee may ask for it a year later".

claims.quote: What a client tells us at intake and what a seller supplies are held in the engagement file, for the period set in the engagement letter, and then deleted
claims.statement: The engagement file includes a deletion process that removes client intake information and seller-supplied materials once the period set in the engagement letter ends.
claims.tier_basis: Failure of the deletion process would leave materials kept longer than stated but still within the engagement file, which violates no stated condition; the firm's paying-for list says nothing about deletion. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: in an environment created for the engagement
claims.statement: A paid review runs in an environment created specifically for that engagement.
claims.tier_basis: If a paid review did not run in an environment created for that engagement, one seller's code could survive into another deal, breaching the walk-away condition as the reliance statement reads it, and the firm cannot repair Tuuyi's infrastructure. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: in an environment created for the engagement and deleted afterwards
claims.statement: The paid-review setup creates an environment dedicated to each engagement and includes a process that deletes that environment when the engagement ends.
claims.tier_basis: If the engagement environment were not dedicated to this engagement or were not deleted when it ends, one seller's code could survive into another deal's review, defeating the isolation the firm relies on and breaching a condition it made a condition of any paid engagement. The firm cannot repair Tuuyi's infrastructure and would have to stop using the service. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: The report names files by their path
claims.statement: The delivered report identifies files by their path.
claims.tier_basis: If the report did not identify files by path, the firm's engineer could not open and confirm the findings, and the firm would be taking the report on trust or commissioning its own diligence — the core of what it is paying for. The firm cannot repair this cheaply given who it said will operate the offering. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "every finding cited to a file and line that the firm's own engineer can open and confirm".

claims.quote: quotes the lines each finding rests on
claims.statement: The delivered report quotes the source lines each finding rests on.
claims.tier_basis: If the report did not quote the lines each finding rests on, the firm's engineer could not confirm the citations itself and the report's whole method of verification fails for this buyer. The firm cannot repair this cheaply given who it said will operate the offering. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "every finding cited to a file and line that the firm's own engineer can open and confirm".

claims.quote: the page after delivery answers questions from the engagement's record
claims.statement: After delivery, a page exists where the client's questions are answered from the engagement's record.
claims.tier_basis: If the post-delivery question page did not exist or did not draw on the engagement's record, the firm would fall back on the report and its own copy of the record to answer committee questions. That fallback is workable but eats time the firm does not have across six deals a year, and the record is what it is chiefly paying to have kept. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: The repository itself stays in the engagement's environment
claims.statement: The seller's repository remains inside the engagement's environment and is not taken out of it.
claims.tier_basis: If the repository were taken out of the engagement environment, the seller's code would no longer sit only on hardware Tuuyi controls, which is one of the six things the firm listed as the whole of what it is paying for. The firm cannot verify containment itself and has made code containment a condition of any paid engagement. Rated against the buyer's stated threshold: "the seller's code kept on hardware Tuuyi controls".

claims.quote: The repository itself stays in the engagement's environment and is deleted with it
claims.statement: The seller's repository is kept inside the engagement environment, and the environment's deletion process covers the repository together with the rest of the environment.
claims.tier_basis: If the deletion process did not cover the repository together with the rest of the environment, one seller's code could survive the engagement and reach a later one, breaching the firm's walk-away condition about seller materials. The firm cannot repair Tuuyi's infrastructure and would have to stop using the service. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: What you type into the contact form is sent by email to the practice
claims.statement: Contact form submissions are sent by email to the practice.
claims.tier_basis: If contact submissions were not sent by email as described, the handling of what visitors type would differ from the website's account, and the firm is retaining this service on the strength of the website's accuracy alone. The buyer has not said what it would lose here; a person should ask. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: What you type into the contact form is sent by email to the practice and is not stored anywhere else
claims.statement: Contact form submissions are stored nowhere besides the email sent to the practice.
claims.tier_basis: If submissions were stored somewhere besides the email, the website's privacy account would be wrong, and the firm assumes the website describes the service accurately and has seen nothing else. No stated threshold names the public contact form; a person should ask. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to keep bots out
claims.statement: The contact form uses Cloudflare Turnstile for bot protection.
claims.tier_basis: If the form did not use Cloudflare Turnstile, the bot protection would be something other than described, a detail of the public site's visitor-facing behaviour. The buyer has not said what it would lose; a person should ask. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: it runs a check in your browser
claims.statement: The Turnstile check runs in the visitor's browser.
claims.tier_basis: If the check ran somewhere other than the visitor's browser, the description of how the visitor's own machine is involved would be inaccurate, a detail of the public site the firm does not operate against. The buyer has not said; a person should ask. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: it runs a check in your browser and sets no cookie
claims.statement: The contact form's bot protection sets no cookie.
claims.tier_basis: If the bot protection set a cookie, the public pages would not be free of cookies as the website suggests, and the firm assumes the website is accurate. No stated threshold names cookies or analytics on the public pages; a person should ask. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.

claims.quote: so that your conversation is yours and you can return to it
claims.statement: A demo visitor who returns to the demo can resume their own earlier conversation, which remains theirs and is not mixed with other visitors' conversations.
claims.tier_basis: If returning demo visitors could not resume their own conversations, or conversations were mixed, the demo would misbehave in a way the firm will never see: it said the demo is of no commercial interest and it will never use it again. Nothing in the firm's plan rests on the demo. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: Your questions and the answers are kept for a few days and then deleted
claims.statement: Demo questions and answers are actually deleted after the retention period passes and are not kept beyond it.
claims.tier_basis: If demo questions and answers were kept beyond the stated retention period, the firm would be unaffected: it ran the demo once, will never use it again, and the hosted demo touches none of its paid engagements. Nothing in the firm's plan rests on demo retention. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: What a client tells us at intake and what a seller supplies are held in the engagement file, for the period set in the engagement letter, and then deleted
claims.statement: Engagement files are actually deleted when the retention period stated in the engagement letter ends and are not kept beyond it.
claims.tier_basis: If engagement files were not actually deleted when the engagement letter's period ends, the firm's stated interest — the working record being kept for the committee a year later — is not harmed; its falsity would mean records kept longer, not shorter, than stated. No stated threshold names deletion timing on Tuuyi's side, and the firm's walk-away conditions concern where materials are visible, not how long they persist in the engagement file. Rated on the scale alone.

claims.quote: The repository itself stays in the engagement's environment and is deleted with it
claims.statement: When the engagement environment is deleted after the engagement, the seller's repository is actually deleted with it and does not survive the deletion.
claims.tier_basis: If the repository survived the environment's deletion, one seller's code could persist past its engagement and reach a later one, which is exactly the failure the firm cannot repair and has made a condition of any paid engagement. The firm has no way to check Tuuyi's deletion and would have to stop using the service. Rated on the practice's reading of the buyer's plan.
